story.title: From an independent engineer to a disciplined team
paragraphs: Erusoft was founded in 2015 by Eray Usta as a focused independent engineering practice. The early years — building e-commerce systems on Magento, WooCommerce and Shopify, developing custom modules and integration pipelines — shaped the company's mindset: whatever stack we choose, the system has to keep breathing alongside the product.

Over time the teams grew, the projects layered, and the client portfolio expanded — from established Turkish enterprises to fast-scaling fintechs and unicorn-stage technology companies. Today Erusoft is an engineering company built on a disciplined team of senior software engineers, system architects and DevOps specialists, shipping software at production-line quality.

At the core of our work is a single principle: the system we build must still be readable, extensible and scalable five years from now. That principle shapes everything from code quality and technology selection to the long-term partnerships we maintain with our clients.

expertise.subtitle: We started with e-commerce on day one; today, custom software and fintech integrations sit alongside it under a single, disciplined engineering flow.

meta.title: Privacy & KVKK Notice — Erusoft
meta.description: How Erusoft processes personal data — KVKK / GDPR-aligned privacy notice.

privacy.intro: We care about the protection of personal data of every visitor to erusoftech.com and every party that gets in touch with us. This document is prepared to inform you about how we process personal data, in line with Turkish Personal Data Protection Law no. 6698 ("KVKK") and aligned with broader GDPR principles.

controller.title: Data Controller
controller.body: Erusoft (Eray Usta) acts as the data controller within the meaning of KVKK. The contact point for any matter under this notice is hello@erusoftech.com

data.title: Personal Data We Process
data.body:
In the course of our communication and service relationships, we process personal data in the following categories:

• Contact data: name, surname, e-mail, phone, company
• Professional / business data: position, industry, scope of requested service
• Technical data: IP address, browser information, page-view statistics (anonymized)
• Form data: any information you submit through forms used to reach us

purpose.title: Purposes & Legal Basis
purpose.body: We process your personal data to respond to your enquiries, establish and perform contractual relationships, improve service quality and meet our legal obligations. The processing relies on the legal bases of "performance of a contract", "legitimate interest" and, where required, "explicit consent" under KVKK Art. 5.

transfer.title: Transfers
transfer.body: Your personal data may be shared with the technology providers we partner with to deliver services (e.g. e-mail providers, cloud infrastructure). Such transfers happen with the technical and administrative measures required by KVKK in place. When data is transferred outside Türkiye, the conditions under KVKK Art. 9 are observed.

collection.title: Collection Method
collection.body: Your personal data is collected directly from you through forms on our site, e-mail correspondence, contractual relationships and — where necessary — phone conversations.

rights.title: Your Rights (KVKK Art. 11)
rights.body:
Under KVKK Art. 11, you have the right to:

• Know whether your personal data is being processed,
• Request information about the processing,
• Learn the purpose and whether the data is used in line with that purpose,
• Know the third parties (in or outside Türkiye) the data is transferred to,
• Request correction if the data is incomplete or inaccurate,
• Request erasure or destruction within the conditions set by KVKK,
• Request that any correction, erasure or destruction is communicated to third parties the data was transferred to,
• Object to outcomes that adversely affect you arising solely from automated analysis,
• Claim compensation if you have suffered damage due to unlawful processing.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: Our site may use strictly necessary and performance cookies to improve user experience. You can manage your cookie preferences and clear existing cookies from your browser settings at any time.

contact.title: Contact & Requests
contact.body: To exercise the rights listed above, please send your written request, accompanied by identification documents, to hello@erusoftech.com. Requests are processed within at most 30 days as required by KVKK Art. 13.
